articles.title: A hacker turned 25 cents of bitcoin into 46 billion fake BTC tokens on a DeFi bridge
articles.snippet: Two software bugs allowed the attacker to create more than 2,000 times Bitcoin’s maximum supply in unbacked syBTC. Symbiosis puts preliminary losses at 9.97 BTC.

articles.title: Nigel Farage-backed Stack BTC plans to acquire a gold dealer for $16 million to fund bitcoin buy
articles.snippet: The proposed acquisition would use cash flow from precious metals sales to build bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes address
articles.snippet: An MEV bot known as “Yoink” front-ran an attacker attempting to exploit a custom Safe module, capturing the stolen rsETH before Kelp temporarily froze the receiving address.

articles.title: Trump Says He’s the Only ‘Guardrails’ AI Needs, Attacks Anthropic and Defends Data Centers
articles.snippet: The president dismissed calls for tighter AI controls as industry leaders push to slow development and address safety failures.

articles.title: Strategy Buys Back $139 Million of STRC, Bitcoin Stack Frozen for Second Week
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin treasury firm slowed its preferred-stock buyback from last week's $176 million pace and left its 845,050 BTC untouched, per a Monday SEC filing.
